title: 1936 Prairie's paired windows get their tall carved hoods
items: In 1904, the paired windows on the south side of 1936 Prairie Avenue's dining wing now stand under tall carved hoods: two scrolled arms curling in over each arch to a capped carving in the middle, about 1.15 m over the windows, as the old photograph shows them. Before, a plain arch with a keystone stood in their place.
The small attic windows above them now sit higher, up among the cornice's brackets, closer to where the photograph puts them.
The hoods' sizes are measured from the photograph; their carving is simplified.
